name: Atul K Mehta
title: Attending Physician
bio:
Dr. Mehta grew up right here in the Denver metro area and is excited to finally be practicing in his home state! 
After completing medical school at Virginia Commonwealth University School of Medicine, he went on to complete his residency at the Cleveland Clinic Foundation and a combined fellowship at the University of Maryland/NIH.
His professional interests reflect his training and include rare inflammatory pulmonary diseases and interstitial lung disease in addition to general pulmonary and critical care medicine. 
Outside of medicine, he enjoys traveling, SCUBA diving, as well as running, hiking, and skiing.
